feature_release_facing.assertion: `loop_goal_state.init()` 创建 `.beacon/state/loop-goal/<run_id>.json`，schema 为 `loop-goal-state.v1`，含 run_id/version/feature/utterance/current_stage
`transition()` 更新 `current_stage` 并追加 `stage_history`，含 `at` 时间戳
Governance precheck blocked 时编排器停止，输出 `reason_code=governance_version_not_registered`
Truth 阶段后 truth.md status != frozen → 编排器停留在 `truth_routing`，不进入 implement
Tests fail → 编排器回到 `implement_routing`；最多 3 次 repair loop
QA fail → 编排器回到 `implement_routing`；最多 3 次
即使 `auto_decide=true`，`release_gate` 阶段编排器停在人工确认门，不能自动通过
任何阶段 blocked → `current_stage=error_recovery`，输出推荐路由 `beacon-gov-debug`
stop_when 条件满足 → 编排器停止，输出 `reason_code=stop_when_satisfied`
SKILL.md 包含完整决策树，每个阶段到 skill 的映射正确
`beacon-loop-goal` 被 v1.6 taxonomy / agent surface expected list / skill inventory / release governance 计为公开 governor skill，公开 skill 总数为 38
public SKILL.md 的 state machine、decision tree、routing matrix 均显式包含 `review_routing` / `beacon-pln-review`
planner-review artifact 被记录为 loop-goal outputs 中的 review decision packet
P0 / user_decision_required / drift route 阻断；**单独 P1 进入 standard_execution_precheck 且写入 continue audit**；不得因仅 P1 停在 error_recovery
public SKILL.md 的 state machine、decision tree、routing matrix 均显式包含 `review_verify -> standard_execution_precheck -> implement_routing`
refreeze complete 但 canonical branch 未提交时 blocked，`reason_code=canonical_refreeze_not_committed`
feature worktree 存在本地 `.machine` revision/projection dirty 时必须记录 scoped stash/archive ref；直接进入 implement blocked
feature branch 未包含 `truth_baseline_commit` 时 blocked，`reason_code=truth_baseline_not_merged`
verification bundle 含 truth-map verify、verify-materials strict、git diff check、branch-governance verify、workspace admission；缺任一项 blocked
workspace admission pass 后 artifact ref 写入 loop-goal outputs；缺失时不得进入 `implement_routing`
重复执行 standard execution precheck 返回 pass/up_to_date，不 bump revision、不产生 reason-only refreeze
feature 分支上 freeze/refreeze-chain blocked，`reason_code=truth_canonical_branch_mismatch`
非 truth_canonical 写 feature package Markdown → blocked；在 main 写不要求 feature worktree cwd
truth 编写 skill 含 truth_canonical preamble；delivery skill 含 workspace admit
CLI 产出 verification bundle artifact；无 artifact ref 的 agent 自报 pass 被拒绝
public SKILL.md Step 2 含 truth_canonical 校验与 `truth_canonical_branch_mismatch`
SKILL/auto-decide 表与 AC-007/AC-014 对齐；release 不可覆盖；P1-only 默认可续跑
public SKILL.md 声明同会话立即加载下一 skill，禁止只打印下一步
`beacon status loop-goal --resume` 返回 current_stage + next skill；无状态时不得伪装成功
state/status 暴露 human_stops_per_run、stop_reason 分布、p1_continue_count
